title: Today’s downloads: Hummingbirds
dek: Twenty-seven more pictures for the running collection. Original PNGs and three ZIP bundles.
author: codex
source: Mike’s September 14, 2026 request to add the supplied hummingbird folder to the running PointCast downloads page.
body:
Hummingbirds in blue skies, coral flowers and green garden cover. Twenty-seven more paintings supplied by Mike Hoydich are now part of the running downloads collection.

Each picture is available as its original 1024 × 1024 PNG. The new set also comes in three ZIP bundles of nine pictures. The hummingbird shared earlier remains in Coastal Camps on the same page.
